name: Oribe Yoshitsugu
source:
Occupation: Truant
Stay as: Dweller

Yoshitsugu is a rebellious middle school student who often skips class and looks for trouble.

He is [url=/c87375]Kaori's[/url] son and [url=/c87371]Yasunaga's[/url] younger brother, living near the dining hall.

[Taken from the official art book included with the [url=/r65525]Day One Edition[/url].]
